safety_disclaimer: Simulation and decision-support prototype only. Hardwired PLC limits remain strictly configurable and separate from AI advisory commands; NOT certified as an industrial safety-instrumented system.

operating_modes.label: Charge
operating_modes.entry_exit_rule: Entry: Dryer idle + thermal/PV surplus >= threshold + T_sand < T_max. Exit: Storage reaches target/T_max, surplus ends, or dryer starts.

operating_modes.label: Discharge
operating_modes.entry_exit_rule: Entry: Dryer active + direct heat insufficient + T_sand > T_min + HTF pump/blower OK. Exit: Dryer stops, NCG covers load, or T_sand <= T_min.

operating_modes.label: NCG Priority
operating_modes.entry_exit_rule: Entry: NCG burner active + O2 <= safety limit. Exit: NCG burner stops or reactor O2 alarm trips.

operating_modes.label: Standby
operating_modes.entry_exit_rule: Entry: Dryer idle + no charging surplus or forecast buffer reached. Exit: Dryer demand starts or surplus charging triggers.

operating_modes.label: Aux Heating
operating_modes.entry_exit_rule: Entry: Dryer active + NCG/solar/storage depleted + blower/aux available. Exit: Solar/NCG/storage recovers or dryer stops.

operating_modes.label: PLC Safe Shutdown
operating_modes.entry_exit_rule: Entry: Invalid/NaN sensor, T_sand >= 600°C, HTF over-temp/pressure/low-flow, high O2, or E-Stop. Exit: Manual PLC reset only.
